objectives.description: Verify Node native type-stripping state as of late 2026 via live web search, not pretraining
objectives.note: Verified against nodejs.org/en/learn/typescript/run-natively (official docs) cross-checked against a nightly v26 build's full version-history table, and the TypeScript 5.8 Microsoft DevBlogs RC/GA announcements. Confirmed: feature added v22.6.0 (flag-gated, --experimental-strip-types); unflagged default v23.6.0/v22.18.0; experimental warning removed v24.3.0/v22.18.0; Stable (stability index 2) in v24.12.0/v25.2.0. Every version threshold written in the report names this source inline.

objectives.description: Add Native type-stripping / no-build TypeScript execution block of rows to the matrix
objectives.note: Added a new ### subsection with a 6-row signal table (script invoking node/node --test on .ts, engines.node threshold, --experimental-strip-types, --experimental-transform-types, --no-strip-types) plus a verified syntax-constraint paragraph, placed after the existing Typecheck/Build table.

objectives.description: Add a row for the no-tsconfig.json project shape, stating what each dependent signal degrades to
objectives.note: Added as a new row in the Module Resolution Modes table: states the tsc typecheck row's primary signal does not fire, and the subsection becomes unanswerable from config, requiring inference from source import style instead.

objectives.description: Add the syntax-constraint note (non-erasable constructs + erasableSyntaxOnly)
objectives.note: Confirmed non-erasable set: enum declarations, namespace/module with runtime code (type-only namespaces are fine), parameter properties, decorators (TC39 Stage 3, unconditional parser error), and tsconfig paths aliases (ignored). Confirmed erasableSyntaxOnly is a real TypeScript 5.8 (Feb/Mar 2025) compiler option enforcing the same constraint at tsc time, specifically for enums/namespaces/parameter properties per the DevBlogs announcement -- decorator coverage under erasableSyntaxOnly specifically was not separately confirmed and is not claimed.

objectives.description: Add preamble sentence: a TypeScript project may legitimately have no tsconfig.json
objectives.note: Added to the matrix's opening preamble paragraph, cross-referencing both the new Native Type-Stripping section and the new Module Resolution Modes no-tsconfig.json row.
